steps.title: Answers
steps.body:
Yes. JPMorgan’s average total Risk Management VaR fell from **$54 million in Q2 2022 to $47 million in Q2 2023**, a **$7 million decrease**, or about **13%** ($7 million ÷ $54 million). The filing attributes the year-over-year decline mainly to lower Credit Portfolio and fixed-income risk. (p. 85)

VaR is a one-day market-risk measure at approximately 95% confidence. (p. 84)
